أسترث (form X)
# أَسْتَرِثْ (ʔastariṯ) /ʔas.ta.riθ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَرَاثَ (istarāṯa)
# أُسْتَرَثْ (ʔustaraṯ) /ʔus.ta.raθ/: first-person singular non-past passive jussive of اِسْتَرَاثَ (istarāṯa)
